title: Complete Sikkim: North Sikkim, Nathula & Pelling
highlights: Indo-China border at Nathula Pass & Tsomgo Lake
Buddha Park Ravangla & Char Dham Namchi

days.label: Day 1
days.title: NJP / IXB to Gangtok - Welcome to Sikkim
days.text: Pickup from NJP Railway Station or Bagdogra Airport. Scenic 4-5 hour drive alongside the Teesta River. Check into your Gangtok hotel and explore MG Marg.

days.label: Day 2
days.title: Gangtok to Lachen - Waterfalls & Valleys
days.text: Travel into the northern Himalayas, stopping at Seven Sisters Waterfall, Butterfly Waterfall, and Chungthang Dam before reaching Lachen.

days.label: Day 3
days.title: Lachen to Gurudongmar Lake & Transfer to Lachung
days.text: Dawn expedition to high-altitude Gurudongmar Lake at 17,800 ft. Afternoon lunch in Lachen, then onward past Bhimnala Waterfall to picturesque Lachung.

days.label: Day 4
days.title: Lachung to Yumthang Valley & Return to Gangtok
days.text: Morning exploration of Yumthang Valley of Flowers, followed by the return drive through mountain roads back to Gangtok for rest.

days.label: Day 5
days.title: Gangtok to Nathula Pass, Tsomgo Lake & Baba Mandir
days.text: High-altitude border excursion to Nathula Pass (14,140 ft), holy Tsomgo (Changu) Lake, and Baba Harbhajan Singh Memorial Temple.

days.label: Day 6
days.title: Gangtok to Pelling via Ravangla Buddha Park & Namchi
days.text: Cross into West Sikkim, visiting the 130-foot Shakyamuni Buddha statue at Ravangla and the pilgrim shrines of Char Dham in Namchi before checking in at Pelling.

days.label: Day 7
days.title: Pelling Local Sightseeing - Skywalk & Heritage
days.text: Visit Pelling Glass Skywalk, Chenrezig Statue, the ancient Rabdentse Palace ruins, Pemayangtse Monastery, and Rimbi Waterfalls.

days.label: Day 8
days.title: Pelling to NJP / IXB Departure
days.text: Wake up to panoramic Kanchenjunga views, then enjoy a relaxed descent to NJP Railway Station or Bagdogra Airport for departure.

included: Dedicated private vehicle for all 8 days
7 Nights hotel accommodation (Gangtok, Lachen, Lachung, Pelling)
All meals in North Sikkim and daily breakfast & dinner in Gangtok and Pelling
All protected area inner-line and army permits arranged
Pick-up and drop-off at NJP Station / Bagdogra Airport
